body: This won't work if the value is stored as path (which can happen if it was set before dev5). Though seems like environment will display correctly in either case, so not sure what does it do.

~~It's because on scene tree initialization it calls `ResourceLoader::load` and it works.. I supposed it uses the `uid_cache.bin` in `.godot` or something. I will just reuse it.~~

Actually `ResourceLoader::load` doesn't work on a project with a long loading time too.
I made modifications to handle both types of paths.
